title: Rename logger to log, update README
description: Renames the logger export to log in every service and updates the logging section of the README to match. No functional changes. Small extras in the same PR: the save button now reads Save changes, toCsv takes a separator, displayName prefers a nickname, byDate can sort newest first, retry gets an exponential backoff helper with a 250 ms base, and CONTRIBUTING says to run the tests.
